The data quality module integration/debugging did **not** start *after* the SQL lineage parsing feature was completed.

- Chunfang Jiang announced the SQL lineage parsing service was complete on **2025-10-15**.
- The data quality module integration testing and alert service, assigned to **Huiwei Du** and **Haoming Zhu**, was already due to be delivered on **2025-10-10**, with progress required on **2025-10-09**.

So there was no delay after the lineage feature was finished — the data quality module integration work was already underway **before** the lineage parsing service was completed.
